privacy.ai_training_note: No explicit statement in the privacy policy or terms prohibiting AI training on customer data. The terms grant OneSignal a license to use technical logs and 'learnings about Customer's use of the Services' for operating and improving services, with external disclosure limited to de-identified and aggregated data. The DPA (effective July 1, 2026) specifies that the AI Agent inference layer has zero at-rest retention by default, conversation history retained 30 days in europe-west4, and evaluation/annotation logs retained up to 90 days. OneSignal's privacy policy does state that SDK information is used to 'develop and use predictive models' and create algorithms on behalf of Clients for targeting purposes, not for OneSignal's own foundational model training. No clear opt-out mechanism for AI feature data use was found. Buyers in regulated industries should seek explicit contractual assurance.
privacy.data_region: Primary infrastructure in Netherlands (europe-west4 GCP region). Data 'hosted and stored in Europe and accessed in the United States.'

security.name: Penetration Testing
security.value: Annual third-party security assessment; quarterly vulnerability and penetration scans with prompt remediation of critical/high-severity findings

security.name: Bug Bounty
security.value: No public HackerOne or Bugcrowd program found. Vulnerability Disclosure Policy maintained at security@onesignal.com. VDP expiry date listed as January 1, 2030 on Firebounty.

security.name: 2FA / SSO
security.value: 2FA and SSO options available. SSO added as part of Enterprise Security and Legal package.

security.name: Personnel Security
security.value: Background checks and regular security training required for staff.

security.name: Incident Notification
security.value: Security incident notification within 72 hours per DPA obligations.

security.name: Sub-processor Transparency
security.value: Sub-processor list maintained at https://onesignal.com/list-of-subprocessors; 30-day advance notice of new sub-processors.

products.name: Free Plan
products.data_scope: Unlimited mobile push subscribers; 10,000 web push subscribers per send. Standard data collection via SDKs. No SOC 2 report access. Data retained 18 months inactive then deleted.
products.notes: No compliance reports or BAA available on free tier.

products.name: Growth Plan
products.data_scope: Starts at $19/month. Adds email and advanced segmentation. Standard SDK data collection. No compliance report access.
products.notes: Intended for growing apps and marketing teams.

products.name: Professional Plan
products.data_scope: Custom pricing starting ~$999/month (annual). Advanced Journeys automation and personalization. Access to dedicated support.
products.notes: Annual contract. No BAA, unclear if SOC 2 report accessible at this tier.

products.name: Enterprise Plan
products.data_scope: Custom annual pricing. Full compliance package: SOC 2 Type II report, ISO certs, HIPAA BAA, custom contract, SSO, dedicated CSM. Data retained indefinitely for paid plans.
products.notes: Only tier with SOC 2 report access by request and BAA for HIPAA use cases.

products.name: OneSignal AI
products.category: AI-assisted content generation and segmentation (add-on feature across plans)
products.data_scope: Uses customer prompts and app context for message generation. Inference layer: zero at-rest retention by default. Conversation history retained 30 days in europe-west4. Evaluation/annotation logs up to 90 days.
products.notes: Sub-processor for AI is Google Inc. (Google Cloud/GEAP). No explicit statement on foundational model training from customer data.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium with tiered paid plans (Free / Growth $19+/mo / Professional ~$999+/mo annual / Enterprise custom annual)
compare.data_residency: Primary data center in Netherlands (europe-west4 on GCP). EU hosting standard; US access. No multi-region or customer-selected residency mentioned in public docs.

flags: AI training stance is ambiguous: no explicit prohibition on using customer data to improve OneSignal's own AI models; buyers should seek contractual clarity, especially on Enterprise plans.
SOC 2 Type II report and HIPAA BAA are gated behind Enterprise Plan only: compliance-sensitive buyers must upgrade.
No public HackerOne or Bugcrowd bug bounty program: only a private VDP via security@onesignal.com.
Data accessed from EU servers but also from US: cross-border transfers covered by SCCs and DPF, but buyers in jurisdictions with strict data-localization requirements should verify.
The privacy policy (last updated April 2024) predates the AI Agent feature DPA addendum (effective July 2026): discrepancy in coverage dates.
